home.upgradeTitle: Unlock smart tips and weather warnings
home.upgradeBody: Get daily care tips and 3-day weather alerts with Plus.
home.smartTipLocked: Daily care tips for this plant come with Plus.

seasonalTips.0: Protect tender perennials from frost — fleece on the coldest nights.
seasonalTips.1: Plan your spring sowing. Order seeds before stock runs low.
seasonalTips.2: Start tomatoes, peppers and basil indoors on a warm windowsill.
seasonalTips.3: Harden off seedlings — a week of daylight outdoors before planting out.
seasonalTips.4: After the last frost, plant out tender crops like courgettes and beans.
seasonalTips.5: Mulch beds to lock in moisture and slow weed growth.
seasonalTips.6: Water deeply in the early morning to reduce evaporation.
seasonalTips.7: Pinch out tomato side-shoots and keep harvesting basil to delay flowering.
seasonalTips.8: Save seeds from your healthiest plants for next year.
seasonalTips.9: Lift the last summer crops and compost spent foliage.
seasonalTips.10: Mulch beds for winter and clean tools before storing.
seasonalTips.11: Order next year's seeds and plan your crop rotation.

sensorSetup.title: Sensor setup guide
sensorSetup.heroBody: Follow these steps to connect your GrowWatch sensor to your home network.
sensorSetup.step1Body: Hold the BOOT button on your ESP32 for 3 seconds until the LED flashes blue. This puts it into setup mode.
sensorSetup.step2Body: Go to your phone's WiFi settings and connect to the network called GrowWatch-Setup. It will appear within a few seconds of step 1.
sensorSetup.step3Body: A setup page may open automatically. If nothing appears, open your browser and go to:
sensorSetup.step3Hint: http://192.168.4.1 — type this in your browser address bar
sensorSetup.step4Body: Select your home network from the list and enter your password. Tap Connect sensor. Your phone will disconnect from GrowWatch-Setup — that's normal.
sensorSetup.step4Hint: Sensor reboots automatically and connects to your home WiFi
sensorSetup.issue1A: Make sure you held BOOT for a full 3 seconds until the LED flashed.
sensorSetup.issue2A: Make sure your phone is still connected to GrowWatch-Setup, not your home WiFi.
sensorSetup.issue3A: Check your password and make sure your network is 2.4 GHz — the sensor doesn't support 5 GHz.
sensorSetup.changingWifiBody: Hold the BOOT button again for 3 seconds and repeat steps 2-4.
